0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_100_000
0.description: In barren fields afar, I sense the stirring of dire foes. Those who wander shall make a stand...and you shall serve as their beacon. I, too, mean to confront this rising threat.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_100_001
1.description: Ere we stride into battle, however, let us steep our souls in song─aye, a performance in your honor...

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_000
2.description: <hex:021A020203>Dawn may banish even the darkest night,<hex:02100103>Yet ever shall primal desires burn.<hex:021A020103>

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_001
3.description: <hex:021A020203>Two swords shall vie to lay them low─<hex:02100103>A blade born of light and a blade forged of might.<hex:02100103>Alas, man may entrust his fate unto but one.<hex:021A020103>

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_002
4.description: Truly, Archon Louisoix had a gift with words. Had circumstances been different, he would have made a magnificent minstrel...

5.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_100_010
5.description: You desire an encore? Very well, it would be my pleasure.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_100_012
7.description: From an era long forgotten,♪<hex:02100103>A blade of midnight drawn,♪<hex:02100103>From a battlefield awakened,♪<hex:02100103>A warrior who bears the dawn...♪

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_100_013
8.description: From an era long forgotten,♪<hex:02100103>A blade of midnight drawn,♪<hex:02100103>From a distant land uncharted,♪<hex:02100103>A warrior who bears the dawn...♪

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_010
9.description: Ever since I first set foot in these lands, I have been haunted by a song.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_011
10.description: It foretold the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era, and of those who would deliver us from doom...

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_020
11.description: Of course, I need not speak to you and yours of the prophetess Mezaya Thousand Eyes's words.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_021
12.description: For in the fires of Carteneau, you witnessed the truth of the <hex:021A020203>Divine Chronicles<hex:021A020103>...

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_022
13.description: And when you emerged from the Praetorium triumphant, you proved yourself a Warrior of Light to the world once more.

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_030
14.description: <hex:021A020203>Ne'er till land consumes sun can sea bear moons,<hex:02100103>Heavens spew crimson flame, hells seep black dooms.<hex:021A020103>

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_031
15.description: <hex:021A020203>Stray seeds quicken in ash's grey embrace,<hex:02100103>Valiant blades forged under the Twelve's good grace.<hex:021A020103>

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_032
16.description: The words of the prophetess Mezaya Thousand Eyes as writ in her <hex:021A020203>Divine Chronicles<hex:021A020103>.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_033
17.description: The “crimson flames” of Dalamud heralded the end of an era...

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_034
18.description: And the “valiant blades” that were the Warriors of Light brought us hope in our darkest hour.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_035
19.description: <hex:021A020203>Seven waning moons see seven suns rise,<hex:02100103>Divine order roils, fallen corpses writhe.<hex:021A020103>

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_036
20.description: <hex:021A020203>Souls from aether far, strangers from strange lands,<hex:02100103>Yester with thine eyes, morrow by thine hands.<hex:021A020103>

21.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_037
21.description: We knew not whom the verses spoke of─not I, nor the Archons, nor any other soul in the realm.

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_038
22.description: The Warriors of Light were lost to us. If not them, who could it be?

23.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_039
23.description: And then came the rumors of one not unlike them─a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> who walked in the light of the Crystal.

24.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_040
24.description: From the moment I saw you, I felt it must be true. Having learned of your deeds in their entirety, I now <hex:021A020203>know<hex:021A020103> it to be true.

25.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_041
25.description: You are as they were, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─a Warrior of Light, and an inspiration to us all.

26.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_050
26.description: <hex:021A020203>Lances of light herald the dawn,<hex:02100103>Beckoning shadows deeper still.<hex:021A020103>

27.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_051
27.description: <hex:021A020203>Splendor dances with shades<hex:02100103>Unsheathed, a rime-kissed blade<hex:02100103>Spills crimson o'er fields of white.<hex:021A020103>

28.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_052
28.description: Archon Louisoix warned us that shadows will accompany the coming of dawn. In answer to ascendant Light, Darkness will gather in opposition...or so I interpret his words.

29.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_053
29.description: What “a rime-kissed blade” signifies, I cannot yet fathom. But I have heard that roses of blood are blooming in the white fields of Coerthas, in ever greater profusion.

30.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_054
30.description: The Twelve keep and defend you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. What tales you'll have to tell when next we meet!

31.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_060
31.description: Into the flesh of Darkness go bringers of Light,♪<hex:02100103>for the flame that flickers in Bahamut's tomb.♪<hex:02100103>In that cloying black stirs a raven white,♪<hex:02100103>clawing blood from a barren womb.♪

32.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_061
32.description: What was slain in silver proud did in golden malice rise.♪<hex:02100103>Metals of infamy and ruin, that every hero must despise.♪

33.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_062
33.description: Do these verses ring a bell, perchance? I wrote this song to immortalize your journey into Dalamud's Shadow.

34.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_063
34.description: One of my most requested songs, especially in those halls and taverns frequented by adventurers. Oftentimes, I can save my voice in the later verses, for the whole place is on its feet by then, belting out the words by heart...

35.name: TEXT_CMNDEFMINSTREL01_00138_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_064
35.description: A touch hyperbolic? Why, 'tis the broad strokes that make a popular ballad! Else we would be singing of mending socks and sitting on cushions, would we not? We shall talk again soon─tell me more tales of derring-do, won't you?
